title: Collimation with globally diverse correlated coset preparations

claims.statement: For every integer N >= 2 and s in Z/NZ, with n = ceil(log2 N), the globally diverse source algorithm in proof.md uses the PCROOT-1 bank and logical collimation with the stated full raw buffer, bounded shuffle, signed-erasure mixer and finite branch. Its total sequential charged work T is O(2^((288675134594813/250000000000000) sqrt(n))) with exactly this representative and exact growth index 1/2. This guarantee holds on every execution branch jointly with the other resource bounds and unconditional full-secret success probability at least 1-2^(-7) for every allowed source in the fifth claim, including the clean source. All outside constants are absolute.

For every integer N >= 2 and s in Z/NZ, with n = ceil(log2 N), the globally diverse source algorithm in proof.md uses the PCROOT-1 bank and logical collimation with the stated full raw buffer, bounded shuffle, signed-erasure mixer and finite branch. It tolerates a fraction epsilon(n) = 1 for every n >= 1 in the precise globally diverse correlated source model in error_model. In particular all acquired registers may be malformed and jointly entangled within the same coset support when the specified diagonal spectral spread condition with gap delta = 2^(-d) holds. The exact raw acquisition count is Q = wC with the public C and w of proof.md Sections 1 and 7. The algorithm recovers the complete secret with probability at least 1-2^(-7) jointly with all four branchwise resource bounds, for every allowed state including the independent ideal source.

structured.error_model: Globally diverse correlated coset-preparation model, valid for every N >= 2 and s in Z/NZ. Let omega = exp(2 pi i/N), chi_k = N^(-1/2) sum_y omega^(ky)|y>, phi_k(s) = (|0> + omega^(-ks)|1>)/sqrt(2), and V_s the span of the orthonormal v_k = phi_k(s) tensor chi_k. Every delivery has the usual (n+1)-qubit shape with n = ceil(log2 N). Let d = ceil(ceil(sqrt(n))/max(1,ceil(log2 n))) and delta = 2^(-d). The Q raw registers are acquired before any solver measurement or private random bits. At most floor(epsilon(n) Q) may be malformed. Clean registers are independent ideal rho_s, in tensor product with all other registers and external systems. Condition on the supplier classical specification, which may be sampled privately with arbitrary classical correlations. Allow either of two types, with no herald, or any classical mixture of allowed specifications. (A) Product spectral preparations: the input is a product across registers conditional on the specification. Each malformed copy can be any density matrix on V_s whose diagonal law p(k) in the v_k basis satisfies |sum_k p(k) omega^(j k)| <= 1-delta for every nonzero j modulo N. The chosen marginals need not coincide and may have coherences within V_s. (B) Correlated spectrally diverse preparations: the m malformed registers have an arbitrary joint density operator supported on V_s^(tensor m), possibly entangled together and with an external reference. If m >= Q/2, its product-basis diagonal is supported on tuples (k_i) at malformed positions for which (1/m) sum_i Re(omega^(j k_i)) <= 1-delta simultaneously for every nonzero j modulo N. If m < Q/2 there is no spectral-spread restriction on that joint diagonal. The supplier may know N, s and the algorithm, but cannot access any delivered system, future randomness, or solver workspace. Only the raw registers are supplied; positions, type, spectra and labels are hidden. The guarantee applies to every allowed source at the stated acquired-copy fraction, including the clean problem.
